steps.text:
The plan is approved, and the design is started as "Planetary gear set" (design d1).

The plan uses module 2 with 20 degree pressure angle: a ring of 32 internal teeth (70 mm outer), a sun of 12 teeth, and three planets of 10 teeth at 22 mm center distance, all 10 mm thick. Gaps are 0.3 mm side to side and 0.4 mm above and below, set for PLA on the 0.4 mm nozzle. The carrier is in the plan as a 60 mm plate with three 4 mm pins, which is my assumption, so tell me if you want only the four gears.

Next I'll build the ring, sun, planets and carrier one feature at a time, then run the fit check and the plan check before slicing for the P1S.

steps.text:
The build is finished through the carrier, but the part does not pass the plan check yet, so I've stopped there.

**What's built (design d1):** a 70 mm ring with 32 internal teeth, a 12-tooth sun, three 10-tooth planets at 22 mm center distance, and a carrier plate with three pins. The carrier pins are 3 mm in 4 mm planet bores, which clears the 0.3 mm side gap.

**What fails:** the fit check still shows all three planets fused to the ring and to the sun. The teeth are simplified trapezoids that are not phased to mesh, so they collide where they should have clearance. I also set the ring rim to 1.2 mm behind the teeth, which keeps the 70 mm outer size, and the carrier raises the overall height to 13.4 mm, not 10 mm.

**How do you want to go on?** I can either rebuild the tooth profiles as true involutes with proper phasing (a larger rebuild of the ring, sun and planets), or keep the current teeth and thin them so they clear, which will look less like a real gear and may not mesh smoothly.
